goal: Recent iOS-family guest running locally using native ARM64 hardware virtualization

candidate.name: UniXNU-droidvm
candidate.boot: edk2-gunyah -> UniXNU.efi -> DarwinBoot.efi -> patched guest XNU

blockers: Reference runtime executable memory sharing uses an out-of-tree host module and /dev/gunyah_share
Reference memory pool depends on gh_hugepage_reserve; Bridge all-THP preparation is a different contract
Reference networking changes host interface addresses; must not copy that path
Reference framebuffer and diagnostic tools read shared guest RAM; must not run against donated protected mappings
17.7.11 kernel prelink hashes and platform drivers do not establish newer iOS support
Reference RAM and MMIO addresses cannot be copied to another topology
Mac has limited free storage; no full firmware/source build fetched
